kind: mathematical conditional energy envelope and illustrative cooling sensitivity, not physical measurements or approved user instructions
proof: If every stored-energy mode has E_dot<=-2E/tau_max and conversion is passive with no external source after unplugging, arbitrary redistribution still gives E_total(t)<=E0exp(-2t/tau_max). Vout<=sqrt(2E_total/Cout_min). Dedicated resistors establish capacitor-mode terms; a PSD magnetic L matrix obeys L/R<=trace(L)/min(R).
conditions: R13 and both output bleeders remain intact in these three scenarios; this is not every single component fault.
All initial capacitor voltages are no greater than the stated loose rating ceilings450/50/63V, with total other initial stored energy<=1mJ. This does not rate the whole circuit for those voltages.
Cout total<=20.592uF and permanent base output capacitance>=8uF; any added panel/input storage must be included independently.

Trace of actual winding self-inductance matrix<=3mH and every winding DCresistance>=1mohm; omitted reactive modes must not have a slower energy-decay constant than the selectedtau. These are acceptance conditions, not a fresh physical measurement.
No battery/external backfeed, primary reinsertion, active negative resistance or energy source is present after unscrewing.
A missing R13, outputbleeder failure, winding fault or unbounded external panel capacitance requires another assessment; the proof cannot waive them.
user_wait_not_selected: An actual user wait is at least max(verified complete-assembly electrical discharge, verified cooling to45C) under accepted conditions, with measurement uncertainty and margins.100s is only this conditional electrical screen; cooler/hotter real structures can require longer.
